newsitem.title: FINLAND: Building, transport, industry boost Finnish May GDP.
newsitem.headline: Building, transport, industry boost Finnish May GDP.

text.p: Finland's gross domestic product increased five percent year-on-year in May, boosted by rising output in construction, transport and communication and industry, Statistics Finland (SF) said on Thursday.
Construction sector output increased 14.5 percent, transport and communication rose seven percent and industrial production adjusted for working days grew six percent, SF said.
Trade and commerce increased nearly three percent and output of other services and public sector activities rose 2.5 percent.
The only major segment posting a decline in output in May was agriculture and forestry, down 1.2 percent, SF said.
